title: That's archaeology.
old_caption: A like on a years-old photo can feel like a sign. It isn't a plan. Attention is easy; intention shows up with a day and a time. You deserve more than crumbs.

title: Dear Gemini…
old_caption: 47 tabs open on 12 people, all typing at once. The stars said close the tabs and pick one chat, and suddenly Gemini is leaning in. Depth over dopamine. How many chats are you juggling right now?

title: Psst. Up here.
old_caption:
Sometimes you just need a nudge to look up. The stars have been waiting to chat about your love life.
Consider this your gentle reminder to listen to what your heart already knows.

title: Dear Aries…
old_caption: Dear Aries: you showed up to the date in boxing gloves, shadow-boxing nobody. You don't have to win the first date. Tag an Aries who needs to sit down for a sec.

title: Dear Leo
old_caption:
Leo, your light is real and the stars adore you for it. Love just works best as a duet.
Ask about their day, then truly listen. Sharing the spotlight is its own kind of glow.

title: Dear Libra…
old_caption: Dear Libra: noodles or sushi, forty minutes in, still on the scale. It's dinner. Just dinner. Tag the Libra holding up your group's reservation.

title: Two stars walk into a group chat
old_caption:
One of you sends fourteen date ideas, the other books a table for two. Same ruler, different dialect.
You're not incompatible, you just talk differently. Learn each other's language with patience.

title: Dear Pisces…
old_caption: First date, minute one, and Pisces is already picturing the ring, two cats and a cottage. Virgo is just sitting there blinking. It's the first date, babe. Pisces, how far ahead are you right now?

title: Dear Sagittarius…
old_caption: Dear Sagittarius: we know. Adventure, freedom, planes. Packed by noon and halfway out of frame already. Tag the Sag whose bag is always by the door.

title: Dear Scorpio
old_caption: Scorpio, you don't have to study their texts like clues. A short "ok." is usually just ok. If you're wondering, ask out loud. Real questions beat silent investigations.
